title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Birthday Gift on Marlowe Rewards Birthday Bonuses
content:
A member who holds a Marlowe & Finch Unlimited plan in force receives an Unlimited gift on their Marlowe Rewards birthday bonus.

| Unlimited plan held by the member | Plan status | Unlimited gift |
|---|---|---|
| An annual plan: Unlimited Student Annual, Unlimited Standard Annual, Unlimited Express Annual or Unlimited Next-Day Annual | active or cancellation pending | 100 points |
| A monthly plan: Unlimited Standard Monthly or Unlimited Express Monthly | active or cancellation pending | 50 points |
| Any other position: no plan, or a plan in trial, past due or expired | any | none |

The gift is a flat number of points added to the birthday bonus. Where the tier held carries no birthday points, no birthday bonus is posted and no gift is added.

## Illustrations (hypothetical members)

- An Unlimited Student Annual plan, active: 100 points.
- An Unlimited Express Monthly plan, cancellation pending: 50 points.
- An Unlimited Standard Annual plan, past due: none.
